title: Drives in Bhawanipore: dogs, food and Smile Notes · AquaTerra
description: AquaTerra's drives in Bhawanipore since 2025: a dog feeding drive, a food handout and the Smile Notes campaign. {count} drives, {years}.
lede: AquaTerra's work in Bhawanipore began in August 2025 with a dog feeding drive. In 2026 it has been a food handout and the Smile Notes campaign, both in March. This page covers {count} drives across {years}, with {volunteers} volunteer turnouts.

sections.heading: a dog drive first
body: The first drive in Bhawanipore was a Tails and Treats dog feeding session on 9 August 2025. Students cuddled, fed and looked after the dogs they met, and the drive reports 65 dogs fed.
Tails and Treats is the dog feeding series AquaTerra runs across the city, and its [page](/impact/tails-and-treats) has the wider story. This is the only dog drive in Bhawanipore on this page.

sections.heading: the food handout
body: On 7 March 2026 a food distribution handed out two boxes of croissants, with twenty packs in each box, near a slum area in Bhawanipore. It was a small team of volunteers, and it is the only food drive in Bhawanipore on this page.
The drive set out to bring smiles and support to the local community, and it is the newest food drive on this page.

sections.heading: smile notes on the street
body: On 25 March 2026 AquaTerra ran the Smile Notes campaign in Bhawanipore. Students handed out 100 notes with affirmations, and each note came with a toffee, so 100 toffees went out alongside them. The aim was to brighten the day of people walking past, through small acts of kindness and positive messages.
The campaign has its own page, [Smile Notes campaign](/impact/smile-notes), which covers the wider work. Here it is the only drive that hands out words rather than food or feeding.

sections.heading: how the work here started
body: Bhawanipore has had three kinds of drive so far: a dog feeding session in August 2025, a food handout in March 2026 and the Smile Notes campaign later the same month. All three drives of 2026 came in March.
The [Alipore page](/impact/alipore) covers the older work in the neighbouring area, from 2022 to 2025, so readers can see how the neighbourhood's drives have grown.

learnings: Bhawanipore is one of the newer places AquaTerra works, with the first drive in August 2025.
The first drive here was a dog feeding session, and the work since has been food and small kindnesses.
Every drive in Bhawanipore handed something directly to people or dogs in the neighbourhood, whether food, notes or toffees.
All of the 2026 work came in March, so the 2026 work so far has been concentrated in one month.
